name: Cassandra
source:
She/Her

She is bright and cheerful at heart, but is also prone to dozing off. She began working at the coffee shop while going to university and living with her parents, but she dropped out of college, so her temporary barista gig became her full-time job. She's trying to save up money to move out of her parents' house, but is bad about spending, especially on booze and pills.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730050/Princess_of_Worlds_End/]Steam[/url]]
